source_text: This perspective holds that delaying the procedure risks non-compliance with fitrah (natural disposition toward purity), and empirical observations in Muslim-majority societies show high acceptance rates (90-100% prevalence) with negligible psychological regret, prioritizing communal religious obligations over secular consent models.
